user.title: Spicetify Bridge Configuration
user.description: Home Assistant runs the WebSocket server that the spicetify-connect-api extension in Spotify connects to.

data_description.host: Network interface the server listens on. Use 0.0.0.0 to accept connections from other devices in your network.
data_description.port: Port the server listens on. Use the same port in the extension's server URL.
data_description.api_key: Shared secret that must match the API key in the extension settings. Use a long random value.
data_description.enable_ssl: Required when Spotify runs on a different device than Home Assistant, because Spotify blocks unencrypted remote WebSocket connections.

ssl.title: SSL / WSS Certificates
ssl.description: Spotify requires WSS (SSL encryption) when Home Assistant runs on a separate server.

data_description.certfile: Certificate file on the Home Assistant host, for example /ssl/cert.pem.
data_description.keyfile: Private key file on the Home Assistant host, for example /ssl/key.pem.

error.cannot_connect: Could not bind to the specified host and port. Is another service using it?
error.ssl_file_not_found: The specified SSL certificate files were not found on the server.

abort.already_configured: A server on this host and port is already configured.

init.title: Spicetify Bridge Options
init.description: Update settings for this Spicetify Bridge instance.

data.restrict_origin: Only accept connections from Spotify Desktop

not_connected.message: The Spotify client is not connected. Make sure Spotify is running and the spicetify-connect-api extension can reach Home Assistant.
